result.title: Reading the Unreadable: Text-Aware Image Super-Resolution Needs Reasoning
result.summary: Text-aware image super-resolution (TAISR) aims to recover high-resolution images from low-resolution inputs while preserving textual content. Existing methods treat this as a visual restoration problem, yet severely degraded text often cannot be read from local visual evidence alone. Humans instead read it by reasoning over image context, logical patterns, and prior knowledge. This raises a fundamental question: Does TAISR need reasoning? To answer this, we introduce two diagnostic tools. The first, ReasonText, is a human-curated benchmark that separates reasoning-required text from locally recoverable text. The second, Ground-Truth Text-Crop Accuracy (GTTCA), is a recognition-based metric that measures text restoration quality without text detection errors. Evaluating twelve recent super-resolution (SR) models, we find a consistent and substantial performance drop on reasoning-required text, revealing a systematic blind spot. Two observations point to a remedy. One is that text-conditioned SR models restore text substantially better when given ground-truth text. The other is that multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can read degraded text in low-resolution images through reasoning. We therefore propose Reasoning Transfer via Captioning (RTC), a training-free plug-in that uses an external MLLM to infer the degraded text and feeds the resulting caption to a text-conditioned SR model. RTC consistently improves all six text-conditioned SR models we evaluate, especially on reasoning-required text. Surprisingly, a real-world SR model with RTC can even outperform the TAISR model with RTC, suggesting that reasoning should be a core design axis for future TAISR.

AI.brief_summary: 论文追问文本感知超分是否需要推理：提出 ReasonText 基准与 GTTCA 指标，区分「必须推理才能读出」与「局部可复原」的文本，发现 12 个 SR 模型在推理型文本上系统性退化；并给出免训练插件 RTC，用外部 MLLM 推断退化文本再以 caption 形式送入文本条件 SR 模型。
AI.relevance_reason: 「局部视觉证据不足、需借助上下文与先验推理」的诊断视角与 LVR 中证据获取、何时该继续看/想的判断直接相关，可供核查其定量结论；但推理被外置为 MLLM 输出文本，未触及内部 latent 状态生成与轨迹，与主线机制仍有距离。
